episodes.title: Mary Russell grew up in a Trotskyite cult and sees risk of coercive control in some Quaker groups
episodes.description:
Quakerology Ep 88:  Mary Russell only realised in her 60s that she had grown up in what could be called a political Trotskyite cult of which her father was leader. We discuss how this experience has informed her awareness of Coercive Control. 
#emmarobertsquakerology #cultsurvivor #quakers 

00:00 – Introduction and starting the spiritual journey
00:44 – Growing up in a far-left political "cult"
02:35 – Childhood beliefs: Workers vs. Capitalists in the playground
04:41 – Reflecting on neglect and coercive control in political groups
05:51 – A teenage rebellion: Joining the Roman Catholic Church
07:44 – Exploring Catholicism and spiritual "bypassing"
10:18 – Mid-life transition: Counseling, therapy, and paganism
11:24 – Finding Quakers through Quaker Quest
12:35 – The concept of "depth and width" in Quaker meetings
14:51 – Outreach as a "Quaker lifesaver"
18:45 – Viewing the path to peace as a process, not a destination
20:10 – "Elephants under the carpet": Addressing lumpy Quaker rooms
22:00 – Identifying coercive control and the need for better safeguarding
24:45 – Recognizing "undue deference" and dominant personalities
32:17 – Legislation and awareness of coercive control in groups
35:34 – How past trauma and triggers affect modern worship
41:20 – The need for more psychological awareness in Quaker facilitation
42:52 – Life in your 80s: Zoom groups and the long haul with Quakers
